title: Comment Spacing
content:
Comment spacing# Comments must have no leading whitespace and exactly one space after #.
Before ❌
# You are reading a comment #You are reading a commentAfter ✅
# You are reading a comment

title: Comment Style
content:
Comment style# Use # for comments.
Before ❌
! You are reading a commentAfter ✅
# You are reading a comment

title: Comment Trimming
content:
Comment trimming# Empty comments at the beginning or end of a comment block with content must be removed. Empty comments between non-empty comments are allowed as separators. A block containing only empty comments is handled by no-empty-comment.
Before ❌
# # one #After ✅
# one

title: No Empty Comment
content:
No empty comment# Comment blocks must have content. A block containing only empty comments is invalid. Empty comments in a block with at least one non-empty comment are handled by comment-trimming or allowed as separators.
Before ❌
# #After ✅
# one

title: No Dangling Continuation
content:
No dangling continuation# Files cannot end with a dangling line continuation. A backslash (\) at the end of a line continues the entry onto the next line, so it must be followed by one.
Before ❌
multiline=line1\ escape=this is backslash \After ✅
multiline=line1\ line2 escape=this is backslash \\

title: Separator Style
content:
Separator style# Entries must use = as the key/value separator.
Before ❌
key:valueAfter ✅
key=value

title: Valid Escape
content:
Valid escape# Entries must have valid escape sequences. For example, unicode escapes must include four hexadecimal digits (\u1234, not \u123).
Before ❌
unicode=\u123After ✅
unicode=\u1234

title: Key Name
content:
Key name# Keys can follow snake_case, camelCase or kebab-case, but not UPPERCASE.
Before ❌
ITEM=value DATABASE_USER=adminAfter ✅
item=value database.user=admin

title: Key Order
content:
Key order# Keys must be in alphabetical order, case-insensitively.
Before ❌
item2=value item1=valueAfter ✅
item1=value item2=value

title: No Duplicate Key
content:
No duplicate key# Duplicate keys are not allowed.
Before ❌
item=value item=otherAfter ✅
item1=value item2=other

title: No Empty Key
content:
No empty key# Keys cannot be empty.
Before ❌
=valueAfter ✅
item=value

title: No Empty Value
content:
No empty value# Values cannot be empty.
Before ❌
item=After ✅
item=value

title: Entry Trimming
content:
Entry trimming# Keys and values cannot have leading or trailing whitespace.
Before ❌
item = valueAfter ✅
item=value

title: No Duplicate Blank Line
content:
No duplicate blank line# Consecutive blank lines are not allowed.
Before ❌
item1=value item2=otherAfter ✅
item1=value item2=other

title: No Leading Blank Line
content:
No leading blank line# File cannot start with a blank line.
Before ❌
item=valueAfter ✅
item=value

title: Trailing Newline
content:
Trailing newline# File must end with a newline character.
Before ❌
item=valueAfter ✅
item=value ↵
